## About

I care a lot about making AI go well, and have spent my career so far doing technical research to help with that!

Currently, I'm a Visiting Student Researcher at Google Deepmind, working on [Chain-of-thought monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.11473). Normally, I'm a PhD student at the University of Toronto, where I am supervised by [Roger Grosse](https://www.cs.toronto.edu/~rgrosse/).

Before I started my PhD, I was part of the founding team at UK's AI Safety Institute---I helped scale the organisation, and started our LLM agents team. I've also been a research intern at [UC Berkeley](https://humancompatible.ai/), worked with [Owain Evans](https://owainevans.github.io/) to better understand LLM generalization, and completed my CS undergrad at the [University of Cambridge](https://www.undergraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/courses/computer-science).
